title: CONNECT-IP ADDRESS_ASSIGN Capsule Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 ADDRESS_ASSIGN capsule behavior.
scope: This verification covers arbitrary capsule count permission, ADDRESS_ASSIGN Type 0x01 and payload layout, zero-or-more Assigned Address entries, Request ID varint encoding, Request ID response/unprompted semantics, IP Version and IP Address length validation, Prefix Length validation and meaning, full-length and prefix source-address permission, zero unused host bits, malformed field handling, omitted-address removal, and empty-capsule removal of all addresses.
preconditions: RFC 9484 target/ipproto scope policy is implemented.
expected_result: The focused ADDRESS_ASSIGN tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 ADDRESS_ASSIGN artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0080-0099 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 ADDRESS_ASSIGN capsule surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
